cohort: 455 singleton late preterm deliveries and a validation cohort of 450 singleton late preterm infants
finding: A six-factor antepartum risk score (premature rupture of membranes, antepartum hemorrhage, medical disorders during pregnancy, prenatal estimation of fetal weight, gestational age at delivery, and mode of delivery) accurately predicted the requirement for NICU admission among late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor for NICU admission and was included in the risk score.
